sha256-folder-verify.title: Folder verify
sha256-folder-verify.description: Copied a folder? Prove the copy is byte-for-byte identical. One double-clickable `.bat`: SHA-256 of every file, per-file progress, resumable.
sha256-folder-verify.zh: 复制完文件夹，确认副本和原件逐字节一致。一个双击就能用的 `.bat`。

RCPlane-SU27.title: Su-27 foam-board plane
RCPlane-SU27.description: A Su-27 cut from one sheet of 5 mm foam board, ducted-fan or propeller version. About ¥3 of board and 15 minutes to build.
RCPlane-SU27.zh: 一张 KT 板切出来的苏-27，涵道版 / 螺旋桨版，板材约 3 元，15 分钟拼好。

Modified-FTVersaWing.title: Versa Wing, modified
Modified-FTVersaWing.description: A flying wing based on the Flite Test Versa Wing, with a laser-cut wooden bay for FPV gear. Tractor or pusher.
Modified-FTVersaWing.zh: 改进版 FT 叛逆者飞翼，带木质 FPV 机舱，前拉 / 尾推任选。

MazeSolver-Astar.title: A* maze game
MazeSolver-Astar.description: Guide the sheep home through a random maze in 40 steps. Stuck? The Help button asks A\* for the way.
MazeSolver-Astar.zh: 带小羊走出随机迷宫，走不出去就让 A\* 算法帮你找路。

planes.note: All plans are DXF files in millimetres, ready for a laser cutter or for printing at 1:1.
planes.note_zh: 所有图纸都是以毫米为单位的 DXF 文件，可以直接激光切割，也可以 1:1 打印后手工切。
